adjudication.rationale: The diff does add `ensure_embeddable` that raises `InvalidAccess` unless `URI(request.referer || '').host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, so it will indeed reject `www.`/subdomain variants and will fail when `Referer` is missing (nil host). However, this behavior is an intentional security gate for embedding: without a referer/host match, the server cannot verify the embedding origin, and `embeddable_host` is explicitly a single host setting (admin can configure the exact host they want to allow). The finding characterizes these deliberate constraints as a defect without evidence they are unintended or incorrect per the diff.
